task: Reconstruct a faithful, coherent, explorable static world from one photograph.
input: The same source photograph; no additional target-scene photographs or geometry. Declare external priors and manual assistance.
resources: Unrestricted offline generation for this quality track. Report generation cost, time, hardware, seeds and manual assistance separately; this is not a matched-cost claim.
alignment: One documented rigid/similarity registration into the frozen source-camera frame, fixed before capturing. No pose-dependent warps, camera changes, hiding layers or per-view regeneration.
camera: Each scene freezes vertical field of view, output aspect and every position/quaternion. Entrants must use that exact path. Candidate geometry must never select or skip cameras.

path.selection: Pilot endpoints were selected once from the saved reference's admitted patrol-v3 views. They are frozen before any challenger is judged.
path.interpolation: Return to the source camera between excursions. Three equal position/quaternion-slerp steps each way, plus the initial source frame. Every sample is required.

rendering: One capture build and settings per representation, declared and frozen before comparisons. No photo overlay, source-view transition, labels identifying the method, selective sharpening, beautification or hidden postprocessing. WOM pilot uses the saved active fitter and saved layout, first world-splat variant (500k), all saved visible layers, Three.js/Spark and a pinned web build/browser recorded in evidence.
review: Show the original photograph, both complete ordered walkthroughs and full-resolution endpoint frames. Anonymous A/B labels; counterbalance presentation order. Never use defect finding text or prior scores as ratings.
coverage: All frozen scenes, generation trials and camera samples are required. A genuine generation/render failure with hashed logs loses against success; both failures tie. Absent evidence or absent ballots is incomplete, not a tie or a dropped scene.
scope: The local pilot tests visual exploration, not interactive control quality, dynamic-world behavior, a population of photographs, or verified geometry in unseen regions. New tasks, capture builds, budgets, datasets or reference outputs require a new course digest.
